In detail

Devon & Cornwall Police recorded 390 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 9.2 per 1,000 residents, the 6th highest rate of Plymouth's 20 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (17), drugs (3), vehicle crime (3); the evening/night score by violent crime (59), anti social behaviour (12), public order (6). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Efford and Lipson safe?

Wandroz currently rates Efford and Lipson in Plymouth as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Plymouth, both by day and after dark. This rating is derived from Devon & Cornwall Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Efford and Lipson safe at night?

At night, Efford and Lipson is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Plymouth. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Efford and Lipson a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Efford and Lipson's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Plymouth) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
